{{Quote|It's too late! They're everywhere now... we're being torn apart... ahh!|Sergeant Sheron's last words|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Sheron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] he was dispatched to [[Asation]] after [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] Gatemaster [[Beltek'k]] informed the Republic officials about the opening of the [[Grand Hypergate]] by [[Kephess]], servant of the [[Dread Masters]]. Nameless creatures poured through the [[Hypergate]] and [[Raid on Asation|attacked]] Republic forces, wiping out six squads. Sheron contacted [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Cobus]] through a holocall and asked for reinforcements, but was killed by the creatures before help could arrive.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Sheron appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the introductory cutscene for the "Terror From Beyond" operation on Republic side.
